summary: Sets a single-byte global flag from a computed value, then forwards the HUD render path. Calls ShortComputation_bad0() to produce a byte, stores it at dword_5C7530 + 128, and returns the result of a HUD-flag renderer (named in source only) called with that byte, literal 0, and the two original arguments a1/a2.

local_names.v2: computed byte value stored to the global and passed to the renderer
local_names.a1: first forwarded argument to the renderer
local_names.a2: second forwarded argument to the renderer

operations.description: Call ShortComputation_bad0() and capture its byte result in v2.
Write v2 as a single byte at dword_5C7530 + 128, setting the global flag cell.
Invoke HUDFlagRendererSecondary(v2, 0, a1, a2) and return its value; the renderer is named in the raw source but carries no callee address evidence in the packet.

unresolved: HUDFlagRendererSecondary has no callee address evidence in the packet; it is described from the raw source name only.
The meaning of the byte stored at dword_5C7530 + 128 (flag/id) is not derivable from this packet.
Owner object identity is not established by the packet.
